name: io.github.intbot/burnwall-mcp-firewall
description: Local MCP firewall: tool-poisoning + rug-pull detection, an approval workflow, and a path/command/secret denylist on tool-call arguments. Runs in front of your MCP servers; nothing leaves your machine.

packages.comment: Install the burnwall CLI (brew/cargo/npm/curl — see the repo). The firewall is a passthrough HTTP proxy started with `burnwall mcp-watch --upstream <your-mcp-server-url>`; point your MCP client at the watcher's local address. See docs/MCP_REGISTRY.md.
